description: Declarative diagram renderer — wraps Mermaid (v1) with VB token-driven theming, lazy load, and HTML-first authoring via fenced code blocks

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a diagram source file (.mmd). Takes priority over inline <pre><code> source; fetched once per URL (not refetched when the element is moved).

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: "lazy" defers render until the element scrolls into view

attributes.name: data-theme-base
attributes.description: Mermaid base theme: base|default|dark|forest|neutral. Default "base" so VB tokens win.

attributes.name: min-height
attributes.description: CSS length reserved for the diagram before render to prevent layout shift

events.name: diagram-wc:ready
events.detail: { svg: string, type: string, source: string }
events.description: After a successful render (initial, source change or theme re-render)

events.name: diagram-wc:error
events.detail: { error: Error, source: string|null, type: string }
events.description: Render or src fetch failed. If nothing has rendered yet the <pre> source is shown with an error note; otherwise the prior figure stays visible

events.name: diagram-wc:source-changed
events.description: The .source setter assigned a new value

events.name: diagram-wc:upgraded
events.description: Fired once after the component upgrades

properties.name: source
properties.description: Get/set the diagram source. Setting it re-renders (the prior figure stays until the new one is ready, and on a parse error) and fires diagram-wc:source-changed. Kept across disconnect/reconnect.

properties.name: svg
properties.description: Serialized markup of the currently rendered SVG, or an empty string before the first render
